evidence: Approved one temporary inclusive 134,217,728-byte ceiling for every complete release ZIP until the measured package-size reduction work is accepted. The application, managed Launcher, and Bootstrap remain independently limited to 80,000,000 bytes; closed inventory, SHA-256, manifest, SBOM, provenance, archive safety, package smoke, and stable-handle verification remain mandatory. Version 1.0.2 is approved only as a one-time fresh/manual installation and makes no managed-upgrade claim from immutable 1.0.0 or 1.0.1.
